description: Activates a structured, hypothesis-driven debugging loop. Use this skill whenever the user reports a bug, unexpected behavior, or runtime error and wants help diagnosing the root cause - especially for bugs that are hard to reproduce or where the fix isn't obvious. Trigger on phrases like: "debug this", "figure out why X is happening", "something is wrong with Y", "I have a bug", "debug-driven", or any request to investigate a runtime issue rather than just apply a code fix. Do NOT use for compile errors with obvious fixes or simple typos - only when runtime investigation is needed.
